envelope.description: Quality's compare and pair stages for cross-chunk duplicates

body.title: Quality's compare and pair stages for cross-chunk duplicates
body.summary: Quality's adapter adds model stages 'compare' and 'pair' after its chunk stage, onCallFailure 'fail-review', run only when the plan is divided. s1 issues every later stage per chunk, so compare's chunkCalls for chunk i packs the chunk's descriptions (from the chunk stage's output) into batches of at most half the limit and pairs each with the batches of every later chunk; each call returns candidate duplicate pairs. pair's chunkCalls for chunk i judges each candidate pair whose first symbol chunk i holds, on both full rows when they fit together, else full against description in each direction, returning today's quality findings with counterpartRef; validate rejects a counterpart outside the pair. Both stages set countAs: 'relation' (s1's AdapterStage.countAs, added by the stakeholder's decision of 2026-10-20), so their calls are counted under pipelineCalls.relation as the LLD's data-model note says, while keeping role 'chunk' for retry and re-division.
acceptanceChecks: Every two symbols in different chunks are compared through their descriptions, in calls that each fit the limit.
Two duplicate symbols in different chunks are named by compare and reported by pair with counterpartRef.
A pair answer naming a counterpart outside its two symbols is rejected, re-issued once, then fails the review.
Under the limit no compare or pair call is made.
Every compare and pair call, re-issues and re-divisions included, is counted under pipelineCalls.relation (countAs: 'relation'), not under chunk.
